rationale: Hrushikesh brings deep healthcare operations and supply chain expertise from Sharp Healthcare, while Jug is a med student actively building healthcare-adjacent products like SwipeBite and a meeting transcriber. Hrushikesh's operational knowledge could help Jug think through the logistics and scalability challenges of shipping healthcare tools, while Jug's hands-on building experience offers a practitioner's perspective on what actually works in the field.
intro_message: Hrushikesh Jadhav, meet Jug — a med student shipping healthcare projects who could benefit from your supply chain and operations perspective, and who can offer real-world building context for healthcare challenges.
